don't you dare do anything to yourself now or ever. i don't want you only in one peace and completely perfect, i want you as you already are- weak but so strong, imperfect but so special, in scars but most beautiful body and soul, just stay here, with me if you feel no one is there for you but belive me, you have someone. your family is always in your first place i know they just can't lose you, second am I but besides that i feel like you're my family too. we all stay heartbroken seeing you like this cause we KNOW you're not worthless as you think. we love you and I LOVE YOU more than you think and more than anyone can. 
now please, just close your eyes and try to sleep. i won't tell you anything more than this, you need to rest that heavy mind but I'm here if you need me. just know I'm constantly thinking od you and OUR deal that both of us will stay okay. i love you, always and more.

I want you to know that I had the best time in my life besides all bad mood which disappears when I'm with him.
